eyebrow.zh: 本地 · 无账号 · 单命令

headline.zh:
把整个仓库
塞进 coding agent 的上下文
headline.en:
Feed your whole repo
into your coding agent

sub.zh: 按缓存感知顺序把 1000+ 文件切片塞进 GLM-5.2 的 100 万 token 窗口，一次 MCP 往返拿到答案——绕过 ChatGPT 的 40 文件上限，单次查询成本低于旗舰模型。
sub.en: Shard 1000+ files in cache-aware order into GLM-5.2's 1M-token window so coding agents fetch the whole repo in one MCP round-trip — past ChatGPT's 40-file cap, below flagship-model per-query cost.

body.zh: 不再被 40 文件上限卡死——整个仓库一次塞进上下文，agent 看全貌再答。
body.en: Stop hitting the 40-file wall — the whole repo goes into context in one shot so the agent sees the full picture before answering.

body.zh: 缓存感知的摄入顺序：依赖清单、README、类型定义先入，之后只重摄入改动文件，不重算整个仓库。
body.en: A cache-aware ingest order: deps, README and type defs go in first, then only changed files are re-ingested — never the whole repo twice.

body.zh: 用国产长上下文模型的 100 万 token 窗口，单次全仓库查询的成本低于旗舰模型，附成本对比仪表盘。
body.en: A domestic long-context model's 1M-token window means a whole-repo query costs less than a flagship model — with a cost-delta dashboard to prove it.

body.zh: stdio MCP 服务器，Claude Code / Cursor / Codex 一次往返拿到整个仓库的答案，数据不离本机。
body.en: A stdio MCP server — Claude Code, Cursor and Codex fetch the whole repo's answer in one round-trip, with data staying on your machine.

headline.zh: 让 agent 看见整个仓库
headline.en: Let your agent see the whole repo

sub.zh: 一条命令装好本地 MCP 后端，绕过文件上限。
sub.en: One command installs the local MCP backend — past the file cap.

tag.zh: 本地 · MIT · 一次往返
